title: Trained versions with their data and exam, and a retirement in one change
request: The owner: do 36.7, the last package of the training-data plan, so every trained version is kept and one that forgets is retired at once.
spec: PHASE12_TRAINING_DATA_PLAN.md 36.7: every trained version kept with its data manifest (sets, replay share, exam version) and its exam result; a version that forgets is retired in one change (models/tuned.retire); training waits for the M1 Max.
plan: Read what exists (tuned switches, exam decisions, replay rounds)
Test first, then the store side

decisions.decision: A version names a replay round that rebuilds byte for byte
decisions.why: the data behind a trained version must always be possible to make again

decisions.decision: Switch serving back before writing anything
decisions.why: nothing may keep serving a version that forgot while its records are written

decisions.decision: Keep the served name apart from the version's own name
decisions.why: the tuned tier serves a model under its server's name, which can differ from the version's

decisions.decision: Build on the existing switches and exam records
decisions.why: one audited way to change serving, one place for exam decisions

change: dclab_core/model_version.py (TrainedVersion v1; dclab-core 0.137.0, schemas, adapter entry), dclab_rnd/store/versions.py, store/layout.py versions(), models/tuned.py (never serves a retired version), CORE_INTEGRATION.md, PHASE12 status, data catalog, tests/test_store_versions.py.

findings.defect: A retirement could switch nothing and still report success
findings.scenario: the version is served under its server's name; retire looked for its own name, found no role, and recorded retired
findings.cause: the served name and the version's name were taken to be the same
findings.fix: the version keeps the name it is served under and the roles are found by it

findings.scenario: an upper-case name or one starting with an underscore
findings.cause: the file name kept characters the store does not allow
findings.fix: the file name is lower-cased and trimmed, with a hash of the real name

findings.defect: A retired version could be served again and its shadow kept running
findings.scenario: with no exam drawn yet, promote after retire saw nothing missing
findings.cause: the serving plan never read the versions, and retire left the shadow on
findings.fix: the serving plan refuses a retired version; retire ends its shadows

findings.defect: The exam's hash could belong to another exam version
findings.scenario: the round names exam v2 while v1 also exists; the record held v1's hash
findings.cause: the hash was taken from the first exam found
findings.fix: the named exam is loaded and its own hash kept

findings.defect: Later exam decisions never joined the history
findings.scenario: a refusal after an acceptance, or a retirement recorded on the exam, was missed
findings.cause: only the last decision joined, and only while the version was still trained
findings.fix: every decision joins once, with the sections it fell on

findings.defect: A retirement stopped half way lost a role from the record
findings.scenario: the first role switched back, the second failed; the rerun named only the second
findings.cause: the roles were found again from the routing on each try
findings.fix: the roles switched are kept beside the record until the retirement finishes; the exam is retired once

findings.defect: Two writers could corrupt or overwrite a record
findings.scenario: a status read while a retirement wrote, or two registrations at once
findings.cause: one shared temporary file name, and a check before the write
findings.fix: each write uses its own temporary file; registration creates the file exclusively

outcome: A trained version can now be kept with the data it was trained on, the name it is served under and its exam, and a version that forgot is retired in one change that switches every role back first; no version exists yet because training waits for the M1 Max.
lessons: Change the live system first, then write the record of the change.
The name a server uses and the name a team uses can differ: keep both.
A change that can stop half way needs a note that lets the next try finish it.
risks: Registering is a command, not yet a step of a training run.
Untested with a real trained model.
